digest.component_or_area: Python core push/delivery and GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Duplicate CAS delivery and retry loops scattered across workflows are consolidated into a single Python core owner at src/rebar/_store/push.py
Strict mode push delivery raises PushDeliveryError with typed failure reasons; best-effort mode preserves backward-compatible default behavior for existing callers
Workflows delegate exactly once to Python strict entrypoints, eliminating local fetch/merge/retry loops and relying on shared five-cycle retry budget
Locked commit-and-push transaction is centralized in Python core with deterministic CAS recovery, preserving working tree and bot identity across staged commits
Library, CLI, MCP, importer, and ticket-store callers retain best-effort defaults while bridge workflows explicitly opt into strict synchronous delivery
